## Outcome (the honest quote)

FP-E quotes **no executable work**: the first-pass compute pool is
spent down to ~$0.33 M headroom (completed 28,192,409 µ$ incl. the
unrun smoke3 ceiling, + Wc reservation 560,740 + W4 fixed 920,740 vs
the $30 A2 cap) → `d_max ≈ 1.04 h`, inside of which
W4's declared overhead+load alone (6,300,000 ms) exceeds the
`D_max − admission-cutoff` room (1,397,185 ms). V5 drops on cost
(`withheld{budget}`); the protected pair truncates on the wall rule
(`withheld{window_deadline}`); pi and claude-code stay held on PP0
admission evidence (`withheld{admission:AG3}`); every primary claim
refuses typed. The comparative quote, the W4 re-issue inputs and the
re-issued `hh-compute-quote/1` are the priced menu for the operator —
**the quote authorizes nothing**; `next_ticket: HUMAN-H15` decides the
release (or `NOT_NEEDED` for the model purchase, as recorded).
